title: Canonical strict-henselization comparison preserves the structural map and closed fibre
statement: Let S be a scheme, Ω an algebraically closed field and s : Spec Ω → S. Let C_small be the chosen small representative coordinate-ring colimit defining strictHenselizationScheme s in [def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-limit], let C_full be the full affine-neighbourhood colimit defining strictLocalization s, and let c : C_small ≅ C_full be smallStrictHenselizationColimitIso s. Then Spec(c.inv) followed by strictLocalizationToBase s equals strictHenselizationStructuralMap s from [def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-structural-map]. Consequently, for any commutative local ring A, isomorphism e : Spec A ≅ strictHenselizationScheme s, and point x, if the small-model structural image of e(x) is s(closedPoint Ω), then x = closedPoint A, by transporting [lem-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-closed-fiber-forward] along Spec(c.inv).

source.place: Categories Tag 04E7, lemma-cofinal (canonical colimit comparison); Étale Cohomology Tag 04HX, lemma-describe-etale-local-ring (pointed affine-neighbourhood colimit); coprojection formula of smallStrictHenselizationColimitIso. Explicit compatibility and transport proof by C5.

proof.text: The representative affine pointed-neighbourhood category is cofiltered, hence nonempty. Choose an object j; write B for its coordinate ring and f : Spec B → S for its structural morphism. The two structural-map defining equations express the composites through this neighbourhood as strictLocalizationToBase s and strictHenselizationStructuralMap s, respectively.

The inverse coprojection equation Functor.Final.ι_colimitIso_inv for the representative equivalence followed by the affine inclusion says ι_full(j) followed by c.inv is ι_small(j). Apply Spec and compose with Spec(ΓSpecIso B).inv and f. Identify inv (Spec B).toSpecΓ with Spec(ΓSpecIso B).inv by cancelling the canonical affine isomorphism. Associativity and the two equations from the preceding step prove Spec(c.inv) ≫ strictLocalizationToBase s = strictHenselizationStructuralMap s.

For a local affine presentation e, form e′ = e followed by the isomorphism Spec(c.inv) from the small model to strictLocalization s. The structure-map equality just proved turns the assumed small-model fibre equation into the full-model fibre equation. Apply the unchanged upstream forward theorem to e′ and x. Its conclusion is precisely x = closedPoint A. No local-ring structure is chosen on a new arbitrary witness; all comparison data are the existing canonical colimit isomorphism.

lean.statement:
theorem smallStrictHenselizationColimitIso_toBase
    {S : Scheme.{u}} {Ω : Type u} [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω]
    (s : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ S) :
    Spec.map (smallStrictHenselizationColimitIso s).inv ≫ strictLocalizationToBase s =
      strictHenselizationStructuralMap s
